import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorObjSubstrate.TrivialisationRestrict
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleCoherence
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.FunctionField

/-!
# Rational coordinates on a line bundle

A trivialization near the generic point identifies the generic stalk of a
line bundle with the function field. Taking germs then gives compatible
rational coordinates for sections on nonempty opens. This is the first step
in presenting the twisting line bundle in Kleiman's Section 4 construction
as a divisor module on a smooth integral curve.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] (L : X.Modules)

/-- Taking the stalk of the unit module agrees with taking the additive group
of the structure-sheaf stalk. -/
noncomputable def unitStalkIso (x : X) :
    (Modules.presheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).stalk x ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  (preservesColimitIso
    (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat)
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ X.presheaf)).symm

omit [IsIntegral X] in
@[reassoc]
theorem unitStalkIso_germ (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (Modules.presheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).germ U x hx ≫
      (unitStalkIso x).hom =
    (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat).map
      (X.presheaf.germ U x hx) := by
  exact ι_preservesColimitIso_inv
    (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat)
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ X.presheaf) (op (⟨U, hx⟩ : OpenNhds x))

/-- A local trivialization identifies the additive generic stalk with the
additive group of the function field. -/
noncomputable def genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : genericPoint X ∈ W)
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of X.functionField := by
  let x : W := ⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩
  let e' := e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm
  exact ((Modules.restrictStalkNatIso W.ι x).app L).symm ≪≫
    (Modules.toPresheaf W.toScheme ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).mapIso e' ≪≫
    (Modules.restrictStalkNatIso W.ι x).app (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≪≫
    unitStalkIso (genericPoint X)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
@[reassoc]
theorem genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization_germ
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : genericPoint X ∈ W)
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (V : W.toScheme.Opens) (hV : (⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩ : W) ∈ V) :
    L.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) (by exact ⟨_, hV, rfl⟩) ≫
      (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L W hW e).hom =
    (e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm).hom.app V ≫
      (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat).map
        (X.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) (by exact ⟨_, hV, rfl⟩)) := by
  simp only [genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.comp_map, Iso.app_inv, Iso.app_hom]
  erw [← Category.assoc, Modules.germ_restrictStalkNatIso_inv_app W.ι
    (⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩ : W) L hV]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc
    ((Modules.presheaf ((Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).germ V
        (⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩ : W) hV) _ _,
    Modules.germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app W.ι
      (⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩ : W) (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) hV,
    unitStalkIso_germ]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
omit [IsIntegral X] in
private theorem restrictHom_app_smul
    {M N : X.Modules} (W : X.Opens)
    (f : M.restrict W.ι ⟶ N.restrict W.ι) (V : W.toScheme.Opens)
    (r : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) (s : Γ(M, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    f.app V (r • s) = r • (show Γ(N, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from f.app V s) := by
  have hM := Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply W.ι M V r s
  have hN := Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply W.ι N V
    ((W.ι.appIso V).hom r) (f.app V s)
  simp only [Modules.restrictAppIso, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_hom,
    Iso.refl_inv] at hM hN
  change r • s = (show Γ(W.toScheme, V) from r) •
    (show Γ(M.restrict W.ι, V) from s) at hM
  change (show Γ(W.toScheme, V) from r) • f.app V s =
    r • (show Γ(N, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from f.app V s) at hN
  rw [hM, Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  exact hN

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Generic coordinates respect the multiplication of a section by a regular
function, including on opens not contained in the chosen trivializing chart. -/
theorem genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization_germ_smul
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : genericPoint X ∈ W)
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(L, U)) :
    (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L W hW e).hom
        (L.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU (r • s)) =
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU r *
        (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L W hW e).hom
          (L.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU s) := by
  let V : W.toScheme.Opens := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hV : (⟨genericPoint X, hW⟩ : W) ∈ V := hU
  have hI : W.ι ''ᵁ V ≤ U := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hz
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ W.ι ''ᵁ V := ⟨_, hV, rfl⟩
  have he (t : Γ(L, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
      (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L W hW e).hom
        (L.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hη t) =
      X.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hη
        ((e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm).hom.app V t) :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization_germ L W hW e V hV) t
  rw [← L.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hI) (genericPoint X) hη (r • s),
    ← L.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hI) (genericPoint X) hη s,
    ← X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hI) (genericPoint X) hη r]
  rw [L.map_smul]
  change (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L W hW e).hom
      (L.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hη
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hI).op r • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hI).op s)) = _
  rw [he, he]
  let e' := e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm
  change X.presheaf.germ (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hη
      (e'.hom.app V (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hI).op r •
        L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hI).op s)) = _
  rw [restrictHom_app_smul W e'.hom]
  exact map_mul _ _ _

/-- A chosen additive coordinate for the generic stalk of a line bundle. -/
noncomputable def genericStalkIso (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of X.functionField :=
  genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L (hL (genericPoint X)).choose
    (hL (genericPoint X)).choose_spec.1
    (hL (genericPoint X)).choose_spec.2.2.some

/-- Rational coordinates of sections relative to a fixed generic trivialization. -/
noncomputable def rationalSection (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) :
    Γ(L, U) →+ X.functionField :=
  ((L.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU) ≫ (genericStalkIso L hL).hom).hom

/-- The rational coordinate of a section is unchanged by restriction. -/
theorem rationalSection_restrict (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hV : genericPoint X ∈ V)
    (s : Γ(L, U)) :
    rationalSection L hL V hV (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) =
      rationalSection L hL U (hVU hV) s := by
  change (genericStalkIso L hL).hom
      (L.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint X) hV
        (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s)) = _
  rw [L.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  rfl

/-- Rational coordinates are linear for the action of regular functions via
their germs in the function field. -/
theorem rationalSection_smul (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(L, U)) :
    rationalSection L hL U hU (r • s) =
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU r * rationalSection L hL U hU s :=
  genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization_germ_smul L (hL (genericPoint X)).choose
    (hL (genericPoint X)).choose_spec.1
    (hL (genericPoint X)).choose_spec.2.2.some U hU r s

/-- Sections on a nonempty open, viewed linearly in the function field. -/
noncomputable def rationalSectionLinearMap (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] : Γ(L, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] X.functionField where
  toAddHom := rationalSection L hL U
    (((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by
      simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U)))
  map_smul' r s := rationalSection_smul L hL U _ r s

/-- On a trivializing open, the rational sections form a principal submodule
of the function field. -/
theorem rationalSection_range_isPrincipal (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W]
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ q : X.functionField,
      LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL W) =
        Submodule.span Γ(X, W) {q} := by
  let g : Γ(L, W) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, W)] Γ(X, W) :=
    Modules.sectionLinearEquivOfRestrictIso W (e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm)
  let f := rationalSectionLinearMap L hL W
  refine ⟨f (g.symm 1), ?_⟩
  ext z
  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨g t, ?_⟩
    rw [← f.map_smul]
    congr 1
    apply g.injective
    simp
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r • g.symm 1, f.map_smul r (g.symm 1)⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle
